notes.title: SMALL BUGFIX
notes.notes:
Hello, I've fixed a bug that was confusing many players. After completing Hour 4 onwards, the game would make the player return to the main menu as if the game ended there without an ending. This bug is now fixed. Thank you again for playing INSOMNIA! :)

Memento Mori Games

notes.title: SPANISH LANGUAGE ADDED! / BUG FIX
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

We added Spanish in our languages! You can select them in the options from the main menu before starting the chapter.

We also fixed a bug where the difficulty was returning to normal if you were restarting the level even if you selected "easy" or "hard" mode.

Currently available languages are: English, Italian, Chinese (Simplified) and Spanish!

Thank you very much.

I love you.

Memento Mori Games

notes.title: ITALIAN LANGUAGE ADDED! + Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello ladies and gents! 

I added the first language on INSOMNIA which is Italian! You can choose your language in the Main Menu Options.

Also I fixed some bugs:

-Reduced time to pass to the next level in Hour 5-1
-Adjusted the location of a mesh in Hour 4-1
-The "Darkness" nightmare (The one spawning during blackouts) spawns correctly in Hour 6 without trespassing the ground.

Thank you very much for you appreciation! I love you guys!

Best regards,
Memento Mori Games

notes.title: Release date rescheduled
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

Due to upcoming releases, we have to reschedule the release of INSOMNIA to August 1. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

notes.title: INSOMNIA RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! I'm proud to announce that INSOMNIA's full game will be released in June 2024! 

Has been a long journey for me as a solo-dev, I've encountered many problems and obstacles along my development but I'm super happy that I'll be finally able to release my first video game ever made.

Your feedback has been very helpful and I'm working on making the game more fluid in terms of notes, tutorials, and other things.

The game for now, will be english only. But I'm planning to add more languages for the game after release. This includes Italian, Spanish, Ukranian, Russian and others.

I will (of course) also implement a custom mode where you can make your customized level and suffer your own nightmare! (after beating the main game of course).

Thank you very much to everyone and I hope that you'll have fun.

Best regards,
Memento Mori Games

notes.title: NEW DEMO PATCH | Prologue changes, Rebalance, Revamp Font
notes.notes:
Hello players!
Thank you for playing INSOMNIA!
I received many feedback and I decided to fix the problems that people hated the most.

-Prologue changes: I changed the notes making them shorter, converted one of the notes into thought and got rid of that font that you hated forever! (After all, no one wants to stay reading while playing a demo isn't it?)

-Also, we increased the Music Box spawn timer in Hour 2! Now the doll will be less oppressive and the music box won't trigger together with the basement blackout!

Thanks for your cooperation and keep sending feedback! They are crucial for the development and success of INSOMNIA! 

Thank you!

notes.title: NEW PATCH! (Game Balance and Communication)
notes.notes:
Hello, horror gamers!

I received many feedbacks from you and I'm extremely glad about it. Feedback is so important in every environment of life and without it, we would never figure out where we're doing wrong.

Thanks for your feedback we understood that many players are having a hard time figuring out the goal of the game or how to survive the night in INSOMNIA. That's why we released a new patch that will help with this issue.

The patch will include:

-Pop-up message telling the fundamental controls of the game. (This will be available in the Prologue only to not ruin your immersion in the rest of the Demo.)

-An additional note in the Prologue to make you understand what are the steps to take.

-The sound cue range of the killer is bigger and its movement speed has been slightly reduced. We also added proximity sound. You won't be frustrated anymore by finding him in front of you and getting killed. (Careful to sound cues!)

-Riddle notes are now reworked and the keywords on how to counter a certain nightmare are highlighted in read for those who don't want to read the whole note.

-Fuseboxes in the basement now have a flickering LED when the blackout happens in order to be spotted easily.

-General level corrections.


Let me know if you know anything else to be improved in the game. Feedback is not a bad thing. Feedback is a treasure and it's super precious.

Are you stuck? Check this quick guide that I made for you! (SPOILER ALERT!)  https://steamcommunity.com/app/2294670/discussions/0/3818536354783824334/

Thank you very much!

Kind Regards,
Memento Mori Games.
